title: implement BlockGroup

atoms.evidence: self.blocks = Sequential(ResidualBlock(...), *[...]) — ResidualBlock submodules registered via Sequential

Sequential(ResidualBlock(in_feats, out_feats, first_stride), *[ResidualBlock(out_feats, out_feats) for _ in range(n_blocks - 1)]) — only first block changes stride, rest preserve shape; this IS the atom

notes: Clean 3-atom exercise — exactly the block-group-stack atom plus the Module-composition spine. The Help dropdown explicitly states the invariant being taught: 'first_stride only applies to first block; after the first block all subsequent blocks have out_feats==in_feats so they get the identity right branch'. Tight scope.
